body:
Objective: Move/rename two cert images and add a Certifications section to the CV page. Context: CV page is at src/pages/cv/index.astro. All content hardcoded as TS const arrays in frontmatter. Existing sections: technicalStack, coreProjects, experience. Section pattern: `

Title

{data.map(...)}
`. Card style: `rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface/50 p-6 transition-colors hover:border-accent/50`. Mono labels use `font-mono text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.15em] text-accent`. No certifications section exists yet. Images live in public/images/. Action Steps: 1. Move and rename the two cert images: - public/cyber.png → public/images/coursera-cybersecurity.png - public/go.png → public/images/coursera-golang.png (Create public/images/ dir if it doesn't exist) 2. Add a `certifications` const array in the frontmatter of src/pages/cv/index.astro, after the `experience` array: ```ts const certifications = [ { title: "Master Golang Programming from Fundamentals to Concurrency", issuer: "EDUCBA", date: "August 5, 2026", link: "https://coursera.org/share/54e2aa035e749894bbed3095fd72dae7", image: "/images/coursera-golang.png", }, { title: "Cyber Security Fundamentals", issuer: "University of London", date: "July 19, 2026", link: "https://coursera.org/share/2ff823307adc11d32da031d966fd98d1", image: "/images/coursera-cybersecurity.png", }, ]; ``` 3. Add a new Certifications section in the page body, AFTER the Experience section and BEFORE the CTA/download section. Follow the existing section pattern. Each card should show: - The cert image (use `` with src from the cert object, alt text with cert title, styled with `rounded-lg border border-border` and a max width like `max-w-md w-full mb-4`) - Issuer label in mono accent style: `

{cert.issuer}

` - Title: `

{cert.title}

` - Date: `

{cert.date}

` - Verify link: `Verify on Coursera →` 4. Also update the jsonLd schema in the frontmatter if it includes a credential/education array — add the certifications there too if the schema supports it. Constraints: - Follow existing Tailwind v4 conventions (no config file, CSS-first) - Match existing card/section styling exactly - Use plain `` tags (not astro:assets Image component) since images are in public/ - Preserve all existing content and sections Deliverables: - Confirm images moved/renamed - Confirm certifications section added to src/pages/cv/index.astro - Report any issues Prerequisites: Read src/pages/cv/index.astro fully before editing to understand exact structure and insertion points.
